name: Sino-Agri Leading Biosciences Co.,Ltd
summary: Sino-Agri Leading Biosciences Co.,Ltd, established in 2009 and based in Beijing, China, is an agrochemical company dedicated to the entire lifecycle of crop protection products. The firm engages in the research, development, production, and worldwide distribution of agricultural chemicals. Its product portfolio encompasses a variety of essential solutions, including insecticides, fungicides, and herbicides. This company operates as a subsidiary of the China National Agricultural Means Of Production Group Corporation.
